title: Apple FY2022 revenue and net income
text: Apple reported total net sales of $394.3 billion for the fiscal year 2022, compared with $365.8 billion in 2021. Net income was $99.8 billion for fiscal 2022, down from $125.9 billion in the prior year. Management cited strong Services performance and a mixed product cycle, while supply constraints and macroeconomic conditions impacted iPhone and wearable sales. Apple’s annual report also noted that iPhone revenue remained the largest contributor to overall sales.

title: Microsoft FY2023 revenue
text: Microsoft reported revenue of $211.9 billion for fiscal year 2023, up 7% from the prior year. Product and cloud revenue increased, while net income was $72.7 billion. The company highlighted Azure growth, productivity software demand, and continued enterprise expansion. Management stated that operating income improved as the business mix shifted toward higher-margin cloud services.

title: Amazon Q4 2022 net sales
text: Amazon reported net sales of $149.2 billion in the fourth quarter of 2022, compared with $137.4 billion in the year-ago quarter. For the full year 2022, net sales were $514.0 billion, with operating income of $12.2 billion. The company said AWS remained a major contributor to profitability, while retail margins remained compressed due to higher fulfillment costs and lower product mix.

title: NVIDIA FY2023 revenue
text: NVIDIA reported revenue of $60.9 billion for fiscal year 2023, up 61% from the prior year. The company attributed the increase to strong demand for data center products, gaming, and AI acceleration. Gross margin was 69.2% for the fiscal year, reflecting strong product mix and operating leverage. Management noted that data center revenue was the largest business segment during the year.

title: Alphabet FY2022 revenue
text: Alphabet reported total revenues of $282.8 billion in 2022, compared with $257.6 billion in 2021. Google Search, YouTube, and Cloud were the largest contributors to revenue growth. Operating income was $79.4 billion for the year, while net income was $59.7 billion. Management said advertising demand remained resilient despite broader digital ad softness and macroeconomic uncertainty.
